objective: B311, G15 with G16. Freeze a learner in which each rewarded image adds one parity knot over memory distinctions and an image is answered only when the knots force it; score it on fresh blind letter drawings beside the recorded count reader; then add distinctions when the examples contradict each other. title: A learner whose examples are knots
